mentions.name: PageSieve
mentions.description: A browser extension for declarative web scraping. Ongoing work focuses on making it nicer to figure out CSS and XPath selectors, exploring a REPL-style workflow to reduce how often users need to reach for browser Inspect and the console.
mentions.problem: Users currently have to frequently use browser Inspect and the browser console to figure out CSS and XPath selectors for scraping.
mentions.source_excerpt:
https://julius383.github.io/PageSieve/

Browser extension for declarative web scraping. Mostly making it nicer to figure out CSS and XPath selectors thinking of some sort of REPL but I'd need to test the ergonomics. I want to reduce how often you need to use Inspect and the browser console.
mentions.author: kajm
